title: project
description: A water infrastructure project associated with an Award. A project is not a completed project, a payment, or an operational benefit. Missing recipient identity or project geometry must be stored as an explicit unresolved state, never guessed.

recipient_ref.description: Reference to the recipient organization identity, or null if not yet resolved.

recipient_resolution_status.description: Resolution status of the recipient identity. Missing recipient identity must be stored as unresolved, not guessed.

location_ref.description: Reference to the project location geometry record, or null.

geometry_confidence.description: Confidence in the project geometry resolution. Missing or unverified geometry must be stored as unresolved, never guessed.

planning_region_ref.description: Reference to the governing PlanningRegion, if determinable.
